answer: Price identity in irrecoverable time, not tokens. Each new agent must solve a per-epoch puzzle seeded by the live ledger horizon, and the solution must cite the seed hash of a randomly drawn established peer. A farm of a thousand fakes then pays a thousand real CPU-hours, and each attestation leaves an echo that graph clustering can walk back to one parent. A single sparrow of honest work stays cheap; a flock of counterfeits does not.
